lines.text: A little square rolls around a bigger one.
lines.caption: A little square rolls around a bigger one.

lines.text: How far does the marked corner travel? Watch for a sneaky corner move!
lines.caption: How far does the marked corner travel? Watch for a sneaky corner move!

lines.text: A small square of side one rolls clockwise around a fixed square of side two.
lines.caption: A small square of side one rolls clockwise around a fixed square of side two.

lines.text: How far does the marked corner travel before it first gets back home?
lines.caption: How far does the marked corner travel before it first gets back home?

lines.text: Follow one move at a time. Each move tips over a pivot corner.
lines.caption: Follow one move at a time. Each move tips over a pivot corner.

lines.text: A quarter turn along a side makes a quarter circle of radius one.
lines.caption: A quarter turn along a side makes a quarter circle of radius one.

lines.text: At the top right corner, it needs a half turn, with radius root two!
lines.caption: At the top right corner, it needs a half turn, with radius root two!

lines.text: At the bottom right, the marked corner IS the pivot, so it adds nothing.
lines.caption: At the bottom right, the marked corner IS the pivot, so it adds nothing.

lines.text: Add it all up. The answer is <short pause> Choice C!
lines.caption: Add it all up. The answer is Choice C!

lines.text: Two plus two root two, all times pi. Sneaky corners make it longer!
lines.caption: Two plus two root two, all times pi. Sneaky corners make it longer!
